name: suman-gyan
description: Suman Gyan - a personal tutor app for Indian students from Class 1 to 12.

scripts.build: mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json service-worker.js www/ && cp -r icons www/icons
scripts.android: npm run build && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.start: npm run build && npx serve www
